senses.gloss: (b. h.) to interlace, entangle; to be entangled, ramified.—Denom. סֻכָּה.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 7:2">Sabb. VII, 2</cite> <he>והמֵיסֵךְ</he> and the work of the weaver. Y. ib. VII, 10ᶜ top <he>משום מֵיסֵיךְ</he> his act coming under the category of weaving; <he>משום מֵיסֶכֶת</he> her act coming &c.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 8:2">Tosef. ib. VIII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 9:2">IX</cite>), 2 <he>המוסיך שלשה וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (corr. acc.) he who weaves three threads (on the Sabbath); a. fr.

senses.gloss: (denom. of סֻכָּה) to hang over, shade. Ohol. VIII, 2; M. Kat. 5ᵇ אילן המיסך על הארץ a tree (with a seat of uncleanness on one of its boughs) throwing a shadow (forming a tent, cmp. אֹהֶל) over the ground; a. e.; v. סְכָכָה.
ה׳ רגליו to cross one’s feet, euphem. for: to ease one’s self.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 3:2">Yoma III, 2</cite>. Y. Ber. IX, 14ᵇ bot.; a. e.

senses.gloss: to cover with boughs &c., esp. to cover the festive booth (Succah).
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 62b:9">Ber. 62ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>להסך את רגליו</he>, <cite ref="I Samuel 24:4">I Sam. XXIV, 4</cite>, v. supra) <he>מלמד שס׳ עצמו כסוכה</he> this intimates that he shaded himself (retired in a chaste manner) as in a booth.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 1:4">Succ. I, 4</cite> <he>הדלה … וס׳ על גבה</he> if he trained a vine over the booth and put twigs over it.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 1:4">Ib.</cite> <he>אין מְסַכְּכִים בו</he> you must not use it for covering. Ib. 14ᵇ <he>סִיכַּכְנוּ על וכ׳</he> we covered a stable with them.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1">Lam. R. to I, 17</cite> (ref. to <he>בסך</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 42:5">Ps. XLII, 5</cite>) <he>לשעבר … ואילנות מְסַכְּכוֹת וכ׳</he> formerly I went up (to Jerusalem) with trees forming shades over my head; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְסוּכָּךְ</he>; f. <he>מְסוּכֶּכֶת</he>.
<cite ref="Sukkah 8b:4">Succ. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>ובלבד שתהא מס׳ וכ׳</he> provided the Succah is covered according to law.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 42">Gen. R. s. 42</cite> (ref. to <he>עמק סכות</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 60:8">Ps. LX, 8</cite>) <he>עמק שהוא מס׳ וכ׳</he> the valley which is shaded with trees.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 25b">B. Bath. 25ᵇ</cite> Ms. M., v. <cite ref="A01720"><he>אַכְסַדְרָא</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to weave; to intertwine plants; to train a creeper over another plant.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 97a">Men. 97ᵃ</cite> (expl. <he>יֻסַּךְ</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 25:29">Ex. XXV, 29</cite>) the tubes <he>שמְסַכְּכִין בהן וכ׳</he> with which they interweave the show bread (which they lay crosswise between the loaves, to allow the air to pass through).
<cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 1:6">Tosef. Kil. I, 6</cite>, v. <cite ref="O00644"><he>סִיכּוּךְ</he></cite>. Y. ib. II, end, 28ᵇ (not <he>מסבכין</he>).
Lev. R. s. 14, end (ref. to Job X, 11 תשככני) סִכַּכְתַּנִי אינו אומר אלא תְּסוֹכְכֵנִי it does not say, Thou hast woven me, but, Thou shalt weave me (in the future world).

senses.gloss: to form shade, to creep, intergrow. Y. Kil. l. c. דלעת מצרית שהיא מְסַכֶּכֶת the Egyptian gourd which creeps.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>שאין כולן מְסַכְּכִין וכ׳</he> not all of them creep like the Egyptian gourd.
